rules.prompt: No geometry drift: do not change body shape, silhouette, proportions, base footprint, neck finish, shoulder shape, molded detail, swirl, facet, panel, embossing, or camera angle.
No material swaps: glass remains glass, plastic remains plastic, metal remains metal, paperboard remains paperboard, and fabric remains fabric.
No blotchy rendering, cloudy body, dirty haze, pale matte rectangle, compression artifacts, stained background, or washed-out product edges.
No missing, erased, ghosted, background-colored, duplicated, or extra caps; detached components visible in the reference must remain visible.
No mutated applicator: do not turn sprayers into rollers, rollers into sprayers, droppers into pumps, reducers into droppers, or bulb sprayers into modern actuators.
No heavy, long, hard, smeared, directional, detached, duplicate, or floor-plane shadow.
No off-center product, baseline drift, inconsistent family scale, cropped cap, cropped base, cropped detached component, or product edge touching the canvas.
No added labels, text, logos, badges, watermarks, props, hands, flowers, lifestyle scenes, tabletop edges, curtains, wood surfaces, or decorative canvas treatments.
